newsitem.title: UK: Russian nuclear submarine limping to base - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russian nuclear submarine limping to base - agency.

text.p: A nuclear submarine of a Russian Far East fleet is limping back to base after engine trouble but officials say there is no radiation leak, Interfax news agency reported on Saturday.
The Russian agency, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, said the submarine was on operational duty "outside Russia's territorial waters" when it broke down.
Interfax, quoting official sources for its information, said the submarine belonged to the 2nd Kamchatka fleet and was now making its way slowly back to base escorted by other vessels.
The agency quoted a regional civil defence spokesman as saying he had been told by fleet commanders that there was no radiation leak.
It did not name the submarine or give any other details on where it was operating.
